reviews.body:
Thanks for moving this over from `genkit#7073`! Keeping every `Role.SYSTEM` message fixes multi-turn `ai.generate(system=..., messages=...)` calls and multi-section prompts cleanly. Left two small comments on empty text parts (`Part.from_text('')`) and adding a wire-level test in `anthropic_generate_test.py`.

`cache_control` on system parts is still dropped, but that was already broken on `main`. Tracking it separately in #149 so this PR stays scoped.

review_comments.body:
When a `Role.SYSTEM` message has `Part.from_text('')` (for example an empty system row in the Dev UI runner), `texts` is `['']`, so `if texts:` evaluates to `True`.

A single empty `Role.SYSTEM` message returns `''` instead of `None`, an empty `Role.SYSTEM` message ahead of `'Answer in French.'` sends `"system": "

Answer in French."`, and two empty `Role.SYSTEM` messages join to `'

'`, which passes `if system:` in `_build_params` and sends `"system": "

"` on the wire instead of omitting `system`.

Maybe we can check non-empty joined text directly (`if msg.text: system_texts.append(msg.text)`, or `if text := ''.join(texts): system_texts.append(text)`) so empty text parts don't emit leading blank lines or whitespace-only `system` fields?

`test_extract_system_keeps_all_system_messages` only calls the private helper `model._extract_system(messages)` on a `MagicMock`, so `_build_params` and `_to_anthropic_messages` aren't exercised on the wire.

If `_build_params` regresses how `params['system']` is populated (or if a second `Role.SYSTEM` message ever leaks into `params['messages']`), this unit test would stay green.

Could we also add an `ai.generate` test using `FakeClaudeApi` in `packages/genkit-anthropic/tests/anthropic_generate_test.py` (e.g. `ai.generate(model=MODEL, system='...', messages=[Message(role=Role.SYSTEM, ...), ...], prompt='...')`, plus empty `Part.from_text('')` system messages) asserting `api.body()['system']` and that `api.body()['messages']` contains only the non-system turns?
